title: Accessing MYP English eAssessment Results
summary: Learn how MYP English Language and Literature eAssessment results are released, who provides them, key dates, and what to do if a grade seems wrong.
body_markdown:
Accessing MYP English Language and Literature eAssessment results normally means contacting your school’s **MYP coordinator** . MYP candidates do not use the IB’s public candidate results website. The IB releases results to schools through the **IB Information System (IBIS)** , after which each school communicates them to students.


This guide explains the release dates, what the result shows, and what to do if information is missing or a grade appears incorrect. Your school’s instructions take priority because local distribution procedures vary.


### How to access your MYP English Language and Literature result


The standard process is:


1. The IB releases MYP results to registered schools through IBIS.
2. The MYP coordinator or another authorized staff member accesses them.
3. The school communicates each student’s result.
4. The student checks the subject, grade, personal details, and certification information.
5. Questions or formal requests are submitted through the coordinator.


Schools may share results through a secure portal, email, printed statement, or results meeting. Consequently, students at different schools may receive results differently even when the IB release date is identical.


Do not assume that you need an IB candidate portal username and PIN. The IB’s official[assessment FAQ](https://ibo.org/programmes/diploma-programme/assessment-and-exams/getting-results/assessment-faq/) states that the candidate website is unavailable to MYP candidates. Diploma Programme candidate portal instructions therefore do not apply to MYP English Language and Literature.


### When are MYP eAssessment results released?


According to the IB’s current[MYP registration and examination timeline](https://ibo.org/programmes/middle-years-programme/assessment-and-exams/onscreen-examinations/registration/) , results are issued from **12:00 noon GMT** on these dates:


Examination session Results released to schools


May session **1 August**


November session **1 February**


Your school may not distribute results immediately. Coordinators need time to verify the information, and schools may follow local office hours or holiday arrangements. Ask before the end of term when and how results will be shared.


These dates apply to official MYP eAssessment results, not internal reports, predicted grades, or classroom examinations. School-based results follow local procedures and may use different grading methods.


### What will the English Language and Literature result show?


The official MYP English Language and Literature result is reported as a **grade from 1 to 7** . The IB’s[MYP grading and awards guidance](https://ibo.org/programmes/middle-years-programme/assessment-and-exams/grading-and-awards/) explains that MYP course results record the grade achieved in each eAssessment subject.


English Language and Literature is assessed through an externally marked on-screen examination. The final IB subject grade is not simply an average of classroom criterion scores, predicted grades, or reports. These may indicate likely performance, but they remain separate from the externally awarded result.


Students taking additional assessments may also receive results for other subjects, the interdisciplinary assessment, and the personal project. A complete MYP certificate has separate award requirements, so one English result does not confirm that the full certificate has been awarded.


### What students should do on results day


Check the complete record rather than reacting only to the grade:


- Confirm that your name and identifying details are correct.
- Check that **English Language and Literature** appears among your subjects.
- Record the grade exactly as issued.
- Ask whether a formal course results document will follow.
- Report missing, pending, or inconsistent information promptly.


If you cannot find your result, contact the school rather than attempting to create an IB account. Under the[MYP general regulations](https://www.ibo.org/globalassets/new-structure/become-an-ib-school/pdfs/general-regulations-myp-en.pdf) , students and legal guardians normally communicate with the IB through the MYP coordinator.


### Can an MYP English result be challenged?


Students cannot independently request a re-mark from the IB. The school must submit an **enquiry upon results** , commonly abbreviated to **EUR** , on the candidate’s behalf.


A re-mark of an externally assessed on-screen examination can make the grade go **up or down** . The school must obtain the required written consent from the student or legal guardian before submitting a request that could change the result. Confirm the relevant fee, service category, and procedure with the coordinator.


The published timeline lists **15 October** as the final EUR date for the May session and **15 April** for the November session. Raise concerns well before the deadline so the coordinator can explain the possible outcomes, collect consent, process any fee, and submit the request.


### Preparing for a future MYP English eAssessment


Exam-day login details are not credentials for a student results portal. The school administers the on-screen examination and later receives the official results through IBIS.


Students preparing for another session can use[MYP eAssessment preparation strategies](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/tips-for-success-in-myp-eassessments) , a[30-day MYP eAssessment study plan](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/myp-eassessments-30-day-study-plan) , and the[MYP Language and Literature assessment criteria](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/myp-language-and-literature-assessment-criteria-explained) . RevisionDojo’s[MYP English Language and Literature resources](https://www.revisiondojo.com/myp/myp-english-langlit) and guide to[scoring a 7 in MYP Language and Literature](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/how-to-score-a-7-in-myp-language-and-literature) support more targeted practice.


### Conclusion


MYP English Language and Literature eAssessment results are released to schools through **IBIS** , not through a candidate website. They are normally issued on **1 August** for the May session and **1 February** for the November session.


Confirm local arrangements with your MYP coordinator, check every detail, and raise concerns promptly. For future preparation, RevisionDojo’s Study Notes, Questionbank, Flashcards, Mock Exams, and Jojo AI can support the analytical and writing skills assessed in MYP English.
